summary.result: Especially, the exponential L-Q equation of T_N showed a coefficient of determinatino of over 0.9 for irrigation water.
summary.background: The concentration and load of T-N and T-P in paddy field areas in Chongwon, Chungbuk , Korea , were investigated during the irrigation period.
summary.method: The average T-N concentration in irrigation water was 2.3 ∼3.2mg/l and therefore the agricultural water quality standard at on-farm level for T-N should be established realistically .
